routeAdjustment: The existing coefficient-field proofs already reduce canonical degree to finite-coordinate support, rational residues and a degree-dimension maximum. Reusing their general ingredients supplies the same formula for the actual finite Kummer extension: global Tate trace transfer proves residue vanishing, the existing pole package proves boundedness, the existing Weil rank-one and residue probes prove duality, and the actual repartition-index bridge identifies the source H1 genus. No new completion decomposition or general scheme-theoretic Riemann--Roch machinery is needed.
discharged: The canonical divisor of every nonzero differential on every finite extension of the actual arithmetic modular field has degree twice its source H1 genus minus two. Global residue vanishing follows from the existing actual Tate trace transfer and rational residue theorem. Existing pole packages, global-constant dimension and Weil residue duality discharge all index and dimension assumptions. No canonical-degree, global-residue or Riemann--Roch certificate is assumed by the actual modular consumer.
remaining: The unramified canonical pullback and cover genus formula, followed by the genus inequality for extending reductions, remain necessary for original-field power lifting and prime-to-characteristic Picard torsion injectivity. Wild good reduction, original arithmetic-action comparison, Frobenius/inertia, residual association, automorphy and all-weight continuation remain required.
